problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬((A∧B)∧A)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
worked_solution:
First, we add a column for the part of the expression that's in parentheses, $A∧B:$

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∧B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Then, we add a column for $(A∧B)∧A:$

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∧B\,$ | $\,(A∧B)∧A\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Finally, we add a column for the negation $¬((A∧B)∧A):$

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∧B\,$ | $\,(A∧B)∧A\,$ | $\,¬((A∧B)∧A)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
